test_title: PYST 35: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.**

Geeta was appointed __________ of Physics in a reputed college in Pune.
solution:
Here the correct answer is** Professor.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correctly spelled word to fill in the blank is **"Professor" (Option 4).**
 
• **"Professor" **refers to **an academic teacher or scholar who is an expert in a particular field and teaches at a college or university. **
 
• The other options (Porfessor, Profesor, and Professur) are misspelled variations of the correct spelling.
 
 
• Example: Geeta was appointed **Professor **of Physics in a reputed college in Pune, where she taught and conducted research on topics related to physics.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 4.**
